name: Throat Blossom
materials: Pink enamel, fine gold chain, a tiny clear stone
story:
The clasp was already on when I lifted it from the bench. A fine gold chain, and the blossom rests at the hollow of the throat. Pink enamel, gold along every petal, a tiny stone at the heart.

It is light on purpose. One flower, close to the skin, so an ordinary day has a single bright thing at the collarbone.
adBody: A pink enamel blossom on a fine gold chain, worn close to the skin.
socialCaption: The pendant, worn. One blossom, gold at the edge, sitting at the hollow of the throat.
altText: A young woman in a cream silk blouse wearing a pink enamel blossom pendant on a fine gold chain.

name: First Blossom
materials: Pink enamel, gold-tone metal, a tiny clear stone
story:
They were still loose on the white bench when the morning light found them. Three pink blossoms, each petal edged in gold. Two hold a tiny clear stone at the heart. One already wears its clasp, ready for a chain. At the edge of the table, a pale daisy the color of the inside of a shell.

I make them small on purpose. A flower you can close your hand around, then wear at the throat on an ordinary Tuesday, so the day has one bright thing in it.
adBody: Pink enamel, gold at every edge, and a pale daisy waiting beside them.
socialCaption: On the bench this morning: three pink blossoms and a pale daisy. One clasp is already on.
altText: A young woman in a cream silk blouse wearing a small pink enamel blossom earring edged in gold.

name: River Link
story: I hammered each link until the gold went matte, then hung a stone I picked up still warm from the bank. It sits low, a small weight you notice when you turn your head.
adBody: Hammered gold and one river stone, made to sit against the collarbone.
socialCaption: New on the bench: a hammered gold chain and a grey river stone. The links are uneven on purpose.
altText: Hammered gold chain necklace with a round grey river-stone pendant on oatmeal linen.

name: Two Clays
materials: Terracotta clay, cream clay, brass hooks
story: The top is the color of a brick after rain. The bottom is the cream clay I keep for quiet shapes. I left the surface a little dry so it catches light like plaster.
adBody: Two clay shapes on a brass hook, pressed by hand and left unglazed.
socialCaption: Unglazed clay earrings in terracotta and cream, with brass hooks. Light enough to forget, until someone asks.
altText: Pair of handmade clay earrings with terracotta tops and cream ovals on a textured white surface.

name: Moss Setting
story: The band is silver I hammered until the marks stayed. The stone is a rough green, set in a bezel that follows its edges instead of forcing a circle.
adBody: A hammered silver ring holding one irregular green stone.
socialCaption: This ring keeps the stone's uneven edge. Silver, hammered, and a green that looks wet in window light.
altText: Hammered silver ring with a rough green stone on dark wood.

name: Three Turns
materials: Ochre, cream, and charcoal linen thread
story: I wound three bands of linen thread until the stack held its own shape. Ochre, cream, charcoal. They sit together like a small landscape on the wrist.
adBody: Three linen cuffs in ochre, cream, and charcoal, wrapped by hand.
socialCaption: Three thread cuffs, stacked. The colors are ochre, cream, and charcoal, wound until the fiber shows.
altText: Three stacked thread-wrapped bangles in ochre, cream, and charcoal on grey stone.
